node.label: Trade & exports
node.summary: India's exports and imports, tariffs and trade deals.

facts.text: India's pharma exports rose **4.9%** to **$16.14 billion** in H1 FY27 (Pharmexcil). **NAFTA** (32.87% share) fell 2.05% to $5.30 bn; **Europe** (20.38%) rose 9.66%; ASEAN grew 21.54%.
